policy: Two separate ladders, not one: the dedicated (VRAM) ladder runs dense models; the unified (CPU/Mac) ladder runs MoE only, because dense does not run well on unified memory. Both converge on Qwen 3.8 Flash Next at 64 GB — the only MoE rung on the dense side. Top of the unified ladder: DeepSeek V4.1 (1017), above Flash Next (engine pending). The Fit List IS the fallback chain: serve auto walks down the chain on OOM/timeout. Cross-cutting rules for every rung: (1) MTP on whenever available; (2) mind the power bill (kWh/hour) — IQ3_S is lossless, so do not push a heavier / higher-draw quant past it (32 GB and 48 GB both stay on Qwen 3.8 27B GSQ-RCO @ IQ3_S). Strata rungs are placed by resident footprint (pack + one expert slab), not by total parameter size: Qwen Flash Next measured 1.5 GB resident at 32K on 2x3090.

12-15gb.note: dense 27B at Q3_K_S (Q3_K_M 12.26 GB also fits)

16-23gb.note: dense 27B at Q4_K_M, lossless for this model and the band default

64gb+.note: MoE; both ladders converge on Flash Next; MTP on
